items.source: Pipeline stages are mapped against the Repository domain type to consider field mappings and may contain simple placeholders ?0 as well as SpelExpressions.
items.translation: 管道阶段与 Repository 域类型进行映射，以考虑 field 映射，并可包含简单占位符 ?0 以及 SpelExpressions。

items.source: Query method Sort and Pageable arguments are applied at the end of the pipeline or can be defined manually as part of it.
items.translation: 查询方法 Sort 和 Pageable 的参数可在管道末尾应用，也可作为管道的一部分手动定义。

items.source: Alias for pipeline(). Defines the aggregation pipeline to apply.
items.translation: `pipeline()` 的别名。用于定义要应用的聚合管道。

items.source: Defines the collation to apply when executing the aggregation.
items.translation: 定义执行聚合时要应用的排序规则。

items.source: Defines the aggregation pipeline to apply.
items.translation: 定义要应用的聚合管道。

items.source: The mode of the read preference to use.
an empty String by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下为空String。

items.source: The Aggregation annotation can be used to annotate a Repository query method so that it runs the pipeline() on invocation.
items.translation: Aggregation 注解可用于标注一个 Repository查询方法，以便在调用时执行 pipeline()。
